en.purpose: To document the clinical severity of myasthenia gravis based on the Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) Clinical Classification, including both class and subclass, to support standardized disease staging and facilitate treatment decisions and clinical trial eligibility assessments.
en.use:
Use to classify adult patients with myasthenia gravis at initial diagnosis and at follow-up visits to document disease severity. The classification is based on the distribution and severity of muscle weakness:
Class input: Describes the overall severity of muscle weakness (e.g., ocular only, mild, moderate, severe, or requiring intubation).
Subclass input: Further specifies the predominant muscle groups involved (a = limb/axial; b = oropharyngeal/respiratory).
Both inputs are recorded as text descriptions, and based on these, the final MGFA class (I, IIa, IIb, IIIa, IIIb, IVa, IVb, V) is assigned.
en.misuse: Not to be used for recording information related to other neuromuscular severity grading systems or outcome measures.

other_details.references: Jaretzki A 3rd, Barohn RJ, Ernstoff RM, Kaminski HJ, Keesey JC, Penn AS, Sanders DB. Myasthenia gravis: recommendations for clinical research standards. Task Force of the Medical Scientific Advisory Board of the Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America. Neurology. 2000 Jul 12;55(1):16-23. doi: 10.1212/wnl.55.1.16. PMID: 10891897.

when: $gt0003|Class|==local::at0007|Any ocular muscle weakness. All other muscle strength is normal.|
then: $gt0007|Description|=local::at0028|Any ocular muscle weakness. May have weakness of eye closure. All other muscle strength is normal.|

when: $gt0004|Subclass|==local::at0014|Predominantly affecting limb, axial muscles, or both. May also have lesser involvement of oropharyngeal muscles.|
then: $gt0007|Description|=local::at0029|Mild non-ocular muscle weakness predominantly affecting limb, axial muscles, or both. May also have lesser involvement of oropharyngeal muscles and ocular muscle weakness of any severity.|

when: $gt0004|Subclass|==local::at0015|Predominantly affecting oropharyngeal, respiratory muscles, or both. May also have lesser or equal involvement of limb, axial muscles, or both.|
then: $gt0007|Description|=local::at0030|Mild non-ocular muscle weakness predominantly affecting oropharyngeal, respiratory muscles, or both. May also have lesser or equal involvement of limb, axial muscles, or both, and ocular muscle weakness of any severity.|

when: $gt0004|Subclass|==local::at0014|Predominantly affecting limb, axial muscles, or both. May also have lesser involvement of oropharyngeal muscles.|
then: $gt0007|Description|=local::at0031|Moderate non-ocular muscle weakness predominantly affecting limb, axial muscles, or both. May also have lesser involvement of oropharyngeal muscles and ocular muscle weakness of any severity.|

when: $gt0004|Subclass|==local::at0015|Predominantly affecting oropharyngeal, respiratory muscles, or both. May also have lesser or equal involvement of limb, axial muscles, or both.|
then: $gt0007|Description|=local::at0032|Moderate non-ocular muscle weakness predominantly affecting oropharyngeal, respiratory muscles, or both. May also have lesser or equal involvement of limb, axial muscles, or both, and ocular muscle weakness of any severity.|

when: $gt0004|Subclass|==local::at0014|Predominantly affecting limb, axial muscles, or both. May also have lesser involvement of oropharyngeal muscles.|
then: $gt0007|Description|=local::at0033|Severe non-ocular muscle weakness predominantly affecting limb and/or axial muscles. May also have lesser involvement of oropharyngeal muscles and ocular muscle weakness of any severity.|

when: $gt0004|Subclass|==local::at0015|Predominantly affecting oropharyngeal, respiratory muscles, or both. May also have lesser or equal involvement of limb, axial muscles, or both.|
then: $gt0007|Description|=local::at0034|Severe non-ocular muscle weakness predominantly affecting oropharyngeal, respiratory muscles, or both. May also have lesser or equal involvement of limb, axial muscles, or both, and ocular muscle weakness of any severity.|

when: $gt0003|Class|==local::at0011|Defined by intubation, with or without mechanical ventilation.|
then: $gt0007|Description|=local::at0035|Defined by intubation, with or without mechanical ventilation (except when used in routine postoperative management). Feeding tube without intubation = Class IVb.|
